name: FPP Pushover Notifications
author: Juan Melendrez
description: Tracks RemoteFalcon song selections and main show start/end events, with configurable event settings and a dashboard.

privacy.summary: The plugin stores local notification preferences and records detected RemoteFalcon song selections and main show start/end events in the FPP media log. This milestone does not send requests to Pushover.

collects.what: Local event history and notification preferences

privacy.other: No requests are sent to Pushover in this milestone. Notification credentials are not stored.
